source.name: USA National Phenology Network, Nature's Notebook status reports
source.note: Data were provided by the USA National Phenology Network and the many participants who contribute to its Nature's Notebook program. Status reports are observer visits, not a census: a site with no dot for a class was not checked for it, and effort differs between sites and weeks.
source.citation: USA National Phenology Network. 2026. Plant and Animal Phenology Data. Data type: Status and Intensity. 2026-08-12 to 2026-10-06. USA-NPN, Tucson, Arizona, USA. Data set accessed 2026-10-06 at https://doi.org/10.5066/F78S4N1V
